name: woslicer-dx
description: Offline desktop BMS wav slicer reimplementing woslicerIII, byte-compatible with the original .wos format and slicer DSP

scripts.typecheck: npm run gen:i18n && vue-tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit
scripts.build: npm run check:version && npm run build:app
scripts.test: npm run test:components && npm run gen:i18n && node -e "fs.rmSync('dist/tests',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && node --test dist/tests/*.test.js
scripts.package: npm run check:version && npm run build:app:tauri && tauri build
scripts.fmt: oxfmt --write src tests scripts vite.config.mts vitest.config.mts playwright.app.config.mts eslint.config.mjs .oxfmtrc.json package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.app.json tsconfig.tests.json tsconfig.lint.json .github/workflows
scripts.fmt:check: oxfmt --check src tests scripts vite.config.mts vitest.config.mts playwright.app.config.mts eslint.config.mjs .oxfmtrc.json package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.app.json tsconfig.tests.json tsconfig.lint.json .github/workflows
scripts.check:quality: npm run lint && npm run fmt:check && npm run typecheck
scripts.build:app: npm run gen:i18n && node scripts/tauri-build-info.mjs && npm run typecheck:app && vite build --config vite.config.mts && node scripts/tauri-build-info.mjs --check --copy dist/app/build-info.json
scripts.build:app:tauri: npm run gen:i18n && node scripts/tauri-build-info.mjs && node scripts/build-app-frontend.mjs tauri && node scripts/tauri-build-info.mjs --check --copy dist/app-tauri/build-info.json
